title: USF Workflow Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for workflow contracts and cross-capability interactions. Each declares its kind (event-workflow-kinds), participants, ordered steps, state transitions, and explicit failure paths and compensation paths, plus related events/interfaces. Workflow ordering, consistency, compensation, and failure semantics are contract-level and MUST NOT be lost in implementation extraction. Governs the ontology concepts Workflow and Event. lifecycleState draft; not active.

failurePaths.$comment: Explicit failure routes; present (may be empty only with recorded rationale).
